---
title: "`r TXT$title`"
subtitle: "`r cap(fill(TXT$subtitle, list(quarter_text = quarter_text(RES$report_quarter))))`"
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
  - \usepackage{float}
  - \floatplacement{figure}{H}
  - \usepackage{caption}
  - \captionsetup{font=small,labelfont=bf,justification=raggedright,singlelinecheck=false}
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 6.7, fig.height = 3, out.width = "100%", fig.path = "figure/")
library(knitr); library(kableExtra)
QT <- quarter_text(RES$report_quarter)
note <- function(key) cat("\\footnotesize Note: ", TXT$notes[[key]] %||% "", " ", TXT$source, "\\normalsize\n\n", sep = "")
kt <- function(d, caption) {
  kbl(d %>% select(-category), booktabs = TRUE, caption = caption, align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(d) - 2))) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 7) %>%
    pack_rows(index = table(factor(d$category, levels = unique(d$category))))
}
ov <- RES$ind %>% filter(quarter == RES$report_quarter, lender != SYSTEM) %>% group_by(lender) %>%
  summarise(b = any(breach_allowance | breach_maturity))
```

# `r TXT$overview$heading`

`r if (sum(ov$b) == 0) fill(TXT$overview$all_ok, list(quarter_text = QT)) else fill(TXT$overview$breaches, list(n_breach = sum(ov$b), n_lenders = nrow(ov), quarter_text = QT))`

```{r overview, fig.height = 3.6, fig.cap = fill(TXT$figures$overview, list(quarter_text = QT))}
g_overview()
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
cat("\\footnotesize Note: ", TXT$overview$note, " ", TXT$source, "\\normalsize\n\n", sep = "")
```
